instruction.name: xvhsubw.d.w
instruction.description: Subtract even-positioned signed 32-bit elements in `b` from odd-positioned signed 32-bit elements in `a`, sign-extending both to 64-bit, to get the 64-bit result.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.notes: Dependent vector-register chain with small positive integer element values.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvhsubw.d.w $xr0, $xr8, $xr16; xvhsubw.d.w $xr1, $xr9, $xr17; xvhsubw.d.w $xr2, $xr10, $xr18; xvhsubw.d.w $xr3, $xr11, $xr19; xvhsubw.d.w $xr4, $xr12, $xr20; xvhsubw.d.w $xr5, $xr13, $xr21; xvhsubw.d.w $xr6, $xr14, $xr22; xvhsubw.d.w $xr7, $xr15, $xr23
